source.order_facts: current canonical order payload.packing, through kernel.ingest
source.parcel_facts: existing fixed CarrierQuoteFixtureSource, with source identity and package digest/revision
source.return_link_meaning: retained canonical lineage references; no refund, stock movement or return eligibility is inferred

authority.operator_identity: authenticated kernel session; never a request field
authority.confirmation: all expected explicit line/ordinal units must have accepted scans, and the caller must supply current packing revision

identity.unit: SHA256 of versioned order resource, line ID and ordinal
identity.scan: SHA256 of tenant, store, scanner ID and scan ID, bound to an immutable command digest
identity.package: one durable session per tenant/store/package, including after cancellation
identity.reservation: one active or shipped allocation per scoped resource/unit enforced by partial unique index
identity.replay: same scan command returns its stored outcome without increasing packed count; conflicting use of that scan identity fails
identity.confirmation: one durable confirmation per session, with operator, expected counts and allocation/source/parcel digests

storage.subject_link: tenant_id, store_id, resource_id on every row
storage.private_payload: body contains operator/scanner IDs, SKU/line/ordinal and return reference/source snapshot details; digest authenticates accidental integrity only
storage.erasure: integration-owned PrivacyLifecycle exports scoped records and redacts body while retaining stable operation/unit identities, state and counters
storage.restore: existing recovery quarantine blocks all packing mutations; retained allocations and scan IDs continue preventing reuse

cancellation.manifested_package: durable manifest membership, including unknown acknowledgment, blocks cancellation; withdrawal is unassigned
cancellation.unshipped_package: release only unshipped reservations; report only currently eligible released units as available
cancellation.cancelled_or_backordered_source_units: remain unavailable even when their local reservation is released
cancellation.return_links: preserve original unit lineage on both old allocation and reallocated eligible unit

faults: executed isolated source increments the packed count before scan deduplication
executed isolated source treats every original eligible unit as available for each package
tests.original_port_025_boundary: local scanner observations and no inventory overstatement only; connected physical receipt and browser/scanner hardware remain unqualified
